verdict.rationale: NotebookLM allows uploading PDFs and other documents as sources, with generous size limits (500k words/200MB per source), and provides grounded chat with in-line citations for research over the uploaded corpus, corroborated by community reports of using it for research workflows. Missing for 10: independent verification of large multi-document corpus handling and no evidence of true autonomous multi-step 'research agent' behavior beyond Q&A/summarization (community notes it can't proactively search for new sources itself).
